title: Entity Look At Entity Behavior
description: Allows the mob to look at nearby entities.

angle_of_view_horizontal.title: Angle Of View Horizontal
angle_of_view_horizontal.description: The angle in degrees that the mob can see rotated on the Y-axis (left-right).

angle_of_view_vertical.title: Angle Of View Vertical
angle_of_view_vertical.description: The angle in degrees that the mob can see rotated on the X-axis (up-down).

domain.title: Domain
domain.description: The domain the test should be performed in.

subject.title: Subject
subject.description: The subject of this filter test.

test.title: Test
test.description: The name of the test to apply.

value.title: Value
value.description: The value being compared with the test.

filters.description:
Filter to determine the conditions for this mob to look at the entity

Properties:
• domain (object)
• operator (object)
• subject (object)
• test (string)
• value (object)

look_distance.title: Look Distance
look_distance.description: The distance in blocks from which the entity will look at the nearest entity.

look_time.title: Look Time
look_time.description:
Time range to look at the nearest entity.

Properties:
• max (float) = 0
• min (float) = 0

defaultSnippets.label: Item Components FloatRange
defaultSnippets.description: Has minimum and maximum float values.

probability.title: Probability
probability.description: The probability of looking at the target. A value of 1.00 is 100%.

item_components_floatrange.title: Item Components FloatRange
item_components_floatrange.description: Has minimum and maximum float values.
